title: 10 of 12 Charges: Huawei Found Guilty in Brooklyn

lines.say: Ten of twelve, according to AFP. A federal jury in Brooklyn has found Huawei guilty.
lines.show: 10 of 12, according to AFP. A federal jury in Brooklyn has found Huawei guilty.

lines.say: Bank fraud. Violating sanctions on Iran. Money laundering. Conspiracy to steal trade secrets.

scene.src: U.S. Dept. of Justice press release 26-1413, Nov 24, 2026

lines.say: The Justice Department says a Huawei employee carried part of a T-Mobile testing robot out of a lab in his backpack.

scene.caption: IMAGE RELEASED BY THE JUSTICE DEPARTMENT · T-MOBILE “TAPPY” TEST ROBOT
scene.src: Trial exhibit released by the Justice Department with the verdict

lines.say: According to AFP, the jury acquitted Huawei of racketeering conspiracy and conspiracy to obstruct justice. Sentencing is set for September twenty twenty-seven.
lines.show: According to AFP, the jury acquitted Huawei of racketeering conspiracy and conspiracy to obstruct justice. Sentencing is set for September 2027.

lines.say: What should a punishment for a company look like?
